source: azseza/smallfish_ ideas measured on real Binance aggTrades and bookDepth

implementation_defect.name: actual fill outside frozen bracket was not revalidated
implementation_defect.mechanism: A signal was risk-sized and bracketed at the completed signal-bar close. The next-minute market fill sometimes opened beyond the structural stop. Nautilus correctly rejected the protective stop as already in the market, but the strategy retained the now-invalid unprotected position until another exit.
implementation_defect.representative_rejection: STOP_MARKET order stop price was in the market at the actual bid/ask
why_material: The executed scenario no longer had the frozen entry-stop-target ordering.
The actual stop-out loss could exceed the current-NAV 3% budget.
Timeout and opposite-state outcomes after the stop rejection are not outcomes of the intended strategy.
implementation_defect.fix: event_lifecycle_patch actual-fill-v1 immediately flattens any fill outside the frozen bracket or above the 3% actual planned-loss budget without moving the stop or target.

continuation.logic_signal: Hundreds of accepted observations are not present, and multiple invalid fills are material; do not issue a clean logic verdict before rerun.

absorption.logic_signal: The accepted valid-looking sample is strongly negative, but formal rejection is deferred until fill-invalidated episodes are handled correctly.

unified.logic_signal: Not eligible for integration because both component families are unclean and negative.

decision_rule: Only the same frozen signals under actual-fill-v1 may determine LOGIC_FAILURE, LOGIC_OPPORTUNITY_FAILURE, or survivor status.
